Seeing Hiyuki's resolve, Gyokuro leaves her with one final blessing: that she no longer remain bound by fate, but step into a spring of her own as an ordinary person.|Journey Log}} ==Steps== #Hiyuki is heading back to the station on her way back to Honami #Return to Honami for the final purge #Complete the final purge ==Gameplay Notes== * Completing the quest awards the ''[[Rover's Journey III]]'' [[Trophy]] ''[[The Bell Still Rings]]''. ==Dialogue== {{Quest Description|With the events of Lahai-Roi over... Hiyuki returns to Honami. After all, she must complete the final Purge.}} {{Dialogue Start}} ;{{Icon/Quest|Main Quests}} Complete the final Purge :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 189 1.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' (Gyokuro must be just ahead...) :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 189 2.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' (This was Honami's last Rite of Purging.) :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 190 1.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' (All is settled. Only one final thing remains.) :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 191 1.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' (I have truly... kept you waiting for too long, Gyokuro.) ---- :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 1.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Finally came to see me? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 2.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Yes. I have come. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 3.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Made up your mind? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 4.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I have. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 5.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Ready to kill me, then? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 6.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' ...Yes. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 7.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Oh? Has my little Hiyuki grown so confident that she can best me without even drawing her blade? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 8.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Now, now... Don't forget who taught the Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura. Can't show a little respect to your elder? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 192 9.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' You call what you did to me teaching, Gyokuro? ---- (''[[#Gallery|Cutscene]] plays'') :Come then, Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura. :... :Calm yourself. :A restless heart makes for unsteady hands. :But... I do not wish to learn this. :Then what do you wish to learn? :This girl will become a great archer. :No, look at her hands... they're a swordsman's hands. :Not in this life. :Her hands aren't ones to hold a blade. Isn't that right? :Well now. You have refined your technique. :Hmph. :Hiyuki... :Do not let the Suzu bind your fate. :Go seek a future of your own. :Focus, Hiyuki. :Survive this strike— :And reach your tomorrow. (''Cutscene ends'') ---- ;Hiyuki tells Gyokuro how much she still misses her—the longing, the resentment, and finally her wish: to become the Miko of Flaming Sakura who defeats the Threnodian, so that Ashinohara will never need another miko after her.
But Hiyuki admits that meeting Rover changed something in her. She no longer despairs over countless failures. Though she knows a future awaits where she burns to ash, knowing she once had a companion on this path makes the pain easier to bear.
Before Gyokuro fades away, she tells Hiyuki that she has always been proud of her. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 1.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Tsk, tsk. You have mastered many skills from others, but have yet to master the bladework of your own Flaming Sakura clan. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 2.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' The last Miko withheld too much. She refused to teach me a single technique. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 3.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Do you resent her? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 4.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I do. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 5.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Even now? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 6.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Every moment. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 7.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I resent that she did not step down long ago. Instead, she burned every future she had and left nothing behind. Not even ashes. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 8.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I resent that she did not pass her skills to me. That she sent me away each time she trained. Now... there is nothing of her left in me. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 9.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Hiyuki... :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 10.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I resent that she always told me to "be myself," yet chose a death that was nothing like herself. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 11.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' And you resent that even after dying, she lingered as a spirit, waiting only for you to send her on. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 12.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Ah. I was being cruel, wasn't I? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 13.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' It's just... I couldn't let my fear go. No one understood the scale of your gift, Hiyuki. Your potential to tame even a Threnodian. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 14.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' If you drew such a future, would everything not become much easier? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 15.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Gyokuro, I... :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 16.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' As long as it comes from your own heart and will, any future you choose is acceptable. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 17.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' But if our little Hiyuki truly became a Threnodian Resonator... Well. I'd have no choice but to follow "family law" and send us both on our way. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 18.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I have already burned that future. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 19.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I accepted the Suzu of my own will. I chose to become the Miko of Flaming Sakura. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 20.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I know why you refused to teach me your swordsmanship. You never wanted there to be another Miko after you. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 21.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I will fulfill that wish, Sister. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 22.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' After Hiyuki, there will be no more Mikos of Flaming Sakura. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 23.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' The Miko of Eternal Flaming Sakura... That is a heavy title to bear. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 24.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' It is. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 25.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' The future ahead is long. Very, very long. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 26.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I know. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 27.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Through the Suzu, we draw strength from countless possible futures. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 28.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' But each time you do, you see yourself draw closer to Miko's destined end. A future burned to cinders, leaving nothing behind. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 29.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Yes. And before that destined end arrives, I will find a way to drive back the Threnodian. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 30.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' So that Gyokuro may simply be Gyokuro. So that Hiyuki may simply be Hiyuki. So that Ashinohara will no longer need a Miko of Flaming Sakura. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 31.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' You have grown up, our little Hiyuki. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 32.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' ... :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 33 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 33 f.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I met someone, Sister. Unlike me, who failed Ashinohara, {{MC|m=he|f=she}} always finds a way to save. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 34.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' That must be difficult for you to bear, little Hiyuki. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 35.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Yes. At first... it was. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 36 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 36 f.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Hearing tales of {{MC|m=his|f=her}} exploits, I felt a deep admiration. No, perhaps it was closer to jealousy. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 37 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 37 f.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I thought, if only I possessed {{MC|m=his|f=her}} strength. Then my days would not be filled with regret. Ashinohara would be saved. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 38.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' And I... in the peace that followed, could have lived an ordinary life. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 39 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 39 f.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' But upon meeting {{MC|m=him|f=her}}, I came to understand. Even a great "savior" carries many pains and failures. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 40.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' And the path of a savior is walked not alone, but alongside countless others. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 41.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Gyokuro. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 42.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Yes? :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 43.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' I have always admired you as the Miko of Flaming Sakura. And I have always... held you in the highest honor. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 44.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Even if one day I am burned to ashes... :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 45 m.ogg}}{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 45 f.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' Because of you.... because of {{MC|m=him|f=her}}... because they all exist... I am never truly alone. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 46.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' I take great pride in you, too. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 47.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' Go on, Shiratori. Fly to where your heart desires. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 193 48.ogg}} '''Gyokuro:''' May the day come when you, too... step into spring as freely as anyone in this world. ---- ;A message arrives for Hiyuki from the Grand Architect: "Ashinohara has vanished in a single day. Congratulations on your wish coming true, Miko of Flaming Sakura." :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 194 1.ogg}} '''Fractsidus Grand Architect:''' Greetings, Miko of Flaming Sakura. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 194 2.ogg}} '''Hiyuki:''' ...You. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 194 3.ogg}} '''Fractsidus Grand Architect:''' Oh, relax. I'm not here to recruit you. I just heard a piece of news and thought you might want to know. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 194 4.ogg}} '''Fractsidus Grand Architect:''' Not long ago, that island floating over the sea, your hometown— :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 194 5.ogg}} '''Fractsidus Grand Architect:''' It vanished. All in a single day. :{{A|Vo zuoyequnxing 194 6.ogg}} '''Fractsidus Grand Architect:''' Congratulations on your wish coming true, Lady Miko. (''Quest complete: Wishes in the Bell: Epilogue'') {{Dialogue End}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Wishes in the Bell: Epilogue |zhs = 愿系铃中·续 |zht = 願繫鈴中·續 |ja = 鈴の音に祈って・続 |ko = 방울에 맺힌 소원 · 속편 |fr = Les vœux dans les clochettes : Épilogue |de = Wünsche in der Glocke: Epilog |es = Deseos en la campana: Epílogo |th = ปรารถนาผูกไว้ในเสียงกระดิ่ง - ตอนต่อ |pt = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.3}} ==Navigation== {{Quest Navbox|Main Quests}} [[zh:愿系铃中·续]]
